frame_samples.name: Ship content
frame_samples.observation: Ship stays on the central vertical axis; fifth content block is below the bow.

frame_samples.name: First veil
frame_samples.observation: A left-side translucent veil overlaps the still-visible ship and last block.

frame_samples.name: Cloud banks
frame_samples.observation: Dense upper-left and bottom/right masses frame a central sea/ship gap.

frame_samples.name: Jet entrance
frame_samples.observation: Jet nose is at the left boundary while distant ship remains visible through the gap.

frame_samples.name: Crossing overlap
frame_samples.observation: Jet nose moves right across clouds before the main trust reveal.

frame_samples.name: Trust reveal
frame_samples.observation: Wing/fuselage crossing reveals porcelain trust from the left; cloud field remains on the right.

frame_samples.name: Tail exit
frame_samples.observation: Trust is exposed; aircraft tail exits right.

measurement_limits: 4-second sampled landmarks establish brackets and event order. Source wall time includes manual scrolling/pauses; it does not establish animation duration, easing, or new scroll progress.

integration_contract.entry: Exact approved ship endpoint; fixed orientation; no cut or camera reset.
integration_contract.overlap: Cloud/ship retreat and jet entry overlap; do not require full ship concealment before aircraft entry.
integration_contract.exit: Accepted J02 wing/fuselage trust mask and exact preset shadow, with full rightward aircraft exit.
integration_contract.status: Unset until selected cloud static outputs are approved and composed.
